name: Ismael 'El Mayo' Zambada García
role: Co-Founder, Sinaloa Cartel (La Mayiza) — In US Custody, EDNY Sentencing Postponed (3rd time) to July 20, 2026; Defense Memo Due July 6
quote: I was ambushed and taken against my will. I had never been arrested before in my 76 years. I will tell the truth about what happened to me.

name: Iván Archivaldo Guzmán Salazar
role: Primary Chapitos Leader, El Chapo's Eldest Son — At Large; ICE $10M Reward Reiterated Apr 14, 2026
quote: The war will not end until we have what is ours.

name: Jesús Alfredo 'El Mochomito' Guzmán Salazar
role: Chapitos Co-Leader, El Chapo's Son — At Large; US Doubles Bounty to $10M (Apr 16, 2026)
quote: Sinaloa has always been ours. Nothing has changed.

name: Joaquín Guzmán López
role: El Chapo's Son — In US Custody, Alleged Orchestrator of Mayo's Capture
quote: I surrendered to the United States of my own free will. I sought to cooperate.

name: Ismael 'Mayito Flaco' Zambada Sicairos
role: La Mayiza Field Commander, El Mayo's Son — At Large
quote: We authorized the offensive on September 9. We will take back everything that belongs to the Zambada family.

name: Fausto Isidro 'Chapo Isidro' Meza Flores
role: La Mayiza Ally, Commands Vitache Special Forces, Controls Northern Sinaloa
quote: Guasave belongs to us and always will. We stand with the Zambada family against the Chapitos.

name: Aureliano 'El Guano' Guzmán Loera
role: El Chapo's Brother — La Mayiza Sierra Commander, Controls Golden Triangle/Badiraguato; Evaded Major Federal Operation Apr 22, 2026
quote: Blood alone does not determine loyalty. The Zambada family has always been the true backbone of Sinaloa.

name: Ovidio 'El Ratón' Guzmán López
role: El Chapo's Son — Extradited to US, Pleaded Guilty, Cooperating Witness
quote: I accept responsibility for my role in the Sinaloa Cartel. I am prepared to cooperate fully with the United States government.

name: Claudia Sheinbaum
role: President of Mexico — 'Not a Protectorate' Declaration (May 10); Rejected US Ground Troops Threat (May 7) and Extradition Demand; Reportedly Met with Rocha Moya and AMLO Over Weekend (May 9-10, 2026)
quote: We are not a protectorate of the United States. We are not a colony. We will never subordinate ourselves — this is a matter of the dignity of the Mexican people.

name: Omar García Harfuch
role: Secretary of Security and Citizen Protection — Sheinbaum Security Chief
quote: We deployed 1,400 additional troops to Culiacán. We are taking territory back from organized crime.

name: Rubén Rocha Moya
role: Former Governor of Sinaloa (on leave) — Federally Indicted by SDNY Apr 30, 2026; Former Residence Attacked by La Mayiza Gunman in Sombrero (May 9); Reportedly Met with Sheinbaum + AMLO Over Weekend
quote: I categorically and absolutely reject these accusations. These charges are false and malicious. I am stepping aside temporarily so these proceedings do not interfere with the state's governance — I will fight these politically motivated lies through legal channels.

name: Yeraldine Bonilla Valverde
role: Interim Governor of Sinaloa — Appointed May 3; Chaired National Security Cabinet May 4 (13,300 troops confirmed); FGR Investigating 50 Officials May 5; Pledged Full Security Strategy Continuity
quote: Asumo el compromiso de velar por la seguridad de Sinaloa. Our priority is the security and welfare of all Sinaloans — federal forces will remain and the security strategy continues without changes.

name: Juan de Dios Gámez Mendívil
role: Mayor (Municipal President) of Culiacán — Federally Indicted by SDNY April 30, 2026 for Alleged Chapitos Drug Escort Orders (~$15,000 USD/Month Bribery)
quote: I deny all the accusations. These charges are entirely false. I have always governed within the law and in service of the citizens of Culiacán.

name: Ricardo Trevilla Trejo
role: Secretary of National Defense (SEDENA)
quote: The Sinaloa Cartel has lost control of 30 of 42 trafficking routes it once dominated. Our operations are degrading their capacity.

name: Anne Milgram
role: DEA Administrator — Announced Mayo's Capture
quote: Today we have dismantled the top leadership of the Sinaloa Cartel — an organization responsible for the majority of fentanyl that has killed Americans.

name: Ken Salazar
role: Former US Ambassador to Mexico (Biden era) — Acknowledged El Mayo Was Taken Against His Will
quote: Zambada was taken against his will. Guzmán López surrendered voluntarily. The United States did not sanction the method by which Zambada was brought to justice.

name: Ronald Johnson
role: US Ambassador to Mexico (Trump era) — Visited Los Mochis Apr 28, 2026; Previewed Federal Indictments of Cartel-Linked Mexican Politicians
quote: The Trump administration is committed to holding accountable every corrupt politician who has enabled organized crime in Mexico. Visa revocations are only the beginning.

name: Héctor Melesio Cuén Ojeda
role: Former Mayor of Culiacán, University Rector — Killed Jul 25, 2024
quote: Cuén died at the same ranch where Mayo was abducted, not in a robbery as the state claimed. Federal evidence confirmed four bullets, not one.

name: 'El Comanche'
role: La Mayiza Senior Field Commander — Authorized September 9 Offensive
quote: Orders issued. The time for waiting is over. Every plaza must act simultaneously.

name: Jesus Omar 'El Chuta' Ibarra Felix
role: Chapitos Security Chief — Indicted Chicago Feb 2026, Fugitive
quote: Las Fuerzas Especiales de Chuta answer to Los Chapitos and no one else. We will defend every plaza with machineguns and fire.

name: Nemesio 'El Mencho' Oseguera Cervantes
role: CJNG Leader — Killed by Mexican Military, February 2026
quote: Jalisco's reach extends wherever we choose to go. Sinaloa is within our interests now.

name: Juan Carlos Valencia González ('El 03')
role: New CJNG Leader — El Mencho's Stepson, US Citizen (Santa Ana, CA), Confirmed April 2026; $5M US Reward
quote: CJNG's operations and strategic interests remain unchanged. Our organization continues on the path El Mencho set.
